name: ihya-e-islam
description: Ihya-e-Islam community portal for Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build: node scripts/bundle.mjs && wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/build
scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name ihya-e-islam --branch main
scripts.format: prettier --write public/index.html public/portal.js public/portal.css public/platform.js public/platform.css public/workflows.mjs public/solutions.mjs public/solutions.css public/overview.mjs public/navigation.mjs public/dashboard.css functions lib scripts tests/*.js wrangler.jsonc package.json README.md
